title: Why? #2 remade: roll two dice, which total comes up most? (predict-first, Remotion, bright, 22 s)

captions.instagram:
NDA Maths · Probability
Roll two dice. Which total comes up most? A 7 · B 12 · C equal
Comment your guess before you watch 👇

Why? #2. Two dice can land 36 equally likely ways. Write each total in the 6×6 grid and every total sits on one diagonal. 7's diagonal is the longest: 6 ways out of 36 → A. 12 has just one (6 + 6).
In the reel: 360 real rolls, and 7 pulls ahead.

NDA 2026 (II) asked it (Maths Q111): P(total is neither 5 nor 7) = ?
5 has 4 ways, 7 has 6 ways → 36 − 4 − 6 = 26 → 26/36 = 13/18 → (c). Trap: (d) 5/6 only removes the 7s.
